source_conflicts.finding: Lap file has timed laps; race file has no matching record. Official classification says DNS.
source_conflicts.action: Left unmatched and excluded from model rows; no invented grid or stint information.

evaluation.metric: MAE of stint slope, seconds/lap of tyre age

stints.decision: Descriptive pace drift only; simulator wear coefficients remain illustrative.
limitations: Exact recorded pit boundaries and distance required; this selects a cleaner subset, not all drivers.
Six usable laps minimum; exclude first race lap, pit laps and physical neighbours.
Median pairwise slope limits outlier influence but does not identify safety-car laps.
Fuel burn, traffic, car/driver pace and track status confound tyre wear; no causal calibration.
Compound names are not a fixed physical specification across seasons or events.
Quartiles show spread across stints, not confidence intervals. Archive inspected retrospectively.

catalogue.scope: Allowlisted dataset metadata only; private report and workbook contents excluded.

issues: Exact duplicate rows need source-aware review, not blind deletion
Event/season provenance and key uniqueness must be verified before integration

source_evidence.evidence: URL references in surviving code, not per-row lineage

reasons: One-token input, not ordered lap windows
